assessment_goal: Explain the purpose and basic structure of an aggregation pipeline, including the flow of documents through stages.
misconception_target: Confusing aggregation pipeline stages with standard find query filters

assessment_goal: Select and apply appropriate aggregation operators (e.g., $match, $group, $project) to transform a sample dataset as specified.
misconception_target: Assuming $match can be used after $group to filter aggregated results

assessment_goal: Analyze an aggregation pipeline to identify performance bottlenecks and recommend indexing or stage reordering.
misconception_target: Believing that adding more $match stages always improves performance regardless of index usage

assessment_goal: Design an aggregation pipeline that computes total sales per product category using embedded and referenced documents.
misconception_target: Treating embedded arrays as separate collections without $unwind

assessment_goal: Interpret aggregation results to derive key business metrics such as conversion rate and average order value, and assess their reliability.
misconception_target: Confusing count of documents with sum of monetary values when calculating averages
